query: SELECT e.id, e.transaction_id, e.occurred_at, e.kind, e.amount, e.balance_after, c.code AS category_code, c.name AS category_name, e.description, e.counterparty_name, e.counterparty_account_id FROM ledger_entry e JOIN category c ON c.id = e.category_id WHERE e.account_id = $1 AND e.search_vector @@ plainto_tsquery('simple', $2) ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT $3

SELECT e.id, e.transaction_id, e.occurred_at, e.kind, e.amount, e.balance_after, c.code AS category_code, c.name AS category_name, e.description, e.counterparty_name, e.counterparty_account_id FROM ledger_entry e JOIN category c ON c.id = e.category_id WHERE e.account_id = $1 AND e.occurred_at >= $2 AND e.occurred_at < $3 ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT $4

SELECT e.id, e.transaction_id, e.occurred_at, e.kind, e.amount, e.balance_after, c.code AS category_code, c.name AS category_name, e.description, e.counterparty_name, e.counterparty_account_id FROM ledger_entry e JOIN category c ON c.id = e.category_id WHERE e.account_id = $1 AND e.search_vector @@ plainto_tsquery('simple', $2) AND c.code = $3 AND e.occurred_at >= $4 ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC, e

SELECT e.id, e.transaction_id, e.occurred_at, e.kind, e.amount, e.balance_after, c.code AS category_code, c.name AS category_name, e.description, e.counterparty_name, e.counterparty_account_id FROM ledger_entry e JOIN category c ON c.id = e.category_id WHERE e.account_id = $1 AND e.counterparty_name ILIKE $2 ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT $3

SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', e.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), 'YYYY-MM') AS month, c.code, c.name, coalesce(sum(e.amount) FILTER (WHERE e.amount > 0), 0) AS credits, coalesce(-sum(e.amount) FILTER (WHERE e.amount < 0), 0) AS debits, count(*) AS entries FROM ledger_entry e JOIN category c ON c.id = e.category_id WHERE e.account_id = $1 AND e.occurred_at >= $2 AND e.occurred_at < $3 GROUP BY
SELECT id, holder_id, holder_name, currency, balance, overdraft_limit FROM account WHERE id = $1
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM account WHERE id = $1)
